issues.text: Round 2, changed text: the first paragraph after the diagram now carries Little's law, the 200 ms arithmetic, the headroom rule, the primary with no number, and the 0.03 refunds in one block. Every step is now there and I could follow it, but I had to read it twice to separate the product-read walk from the order/refund walk.
issues.quote: By Little's law, reads per second per process are 20 divided by the time of one read. At 200 ms that is 100, and under the headroom rule only one of the 2 Pods counts, so 100 falls below the peak of 133.
issues.fix: Start a new paragraph at 'Order placement and refunds meet the primary instead', so the product-read arithmetic and the order/refund check sit in separate paragraphs.
